landing.trustSubtitle: Every layer answers one question a person asks before handing cash to a stranger.

landing.trust_price_body: Every offer is compared against a live market reference. A price far from market is flagged before you commit, and the reference is frozen at match time as evidence.
landing.trust_reputation_body: Ratings can only be given by the two people in a released trade. One rating per trade, no way to inflate.
landing.trust_vouch_body: Members share invite links. Join through one and the inviter is shown as your voucher. A chain of real people behind every handle.

howItWorks.title: How Nomadia works
howItWorks.intro: A plain description of the trade flow, the escrow, and the trust signals. Read this once before your first meetup.
howItWorks.roles_body: One person gives crypto and receives cash, the other gives cash and receives crypto. Whoever holds the crypto side locks it in the escrow contract. The cash side never touches the contract.
howItWorks.steps_body: Every offer moves through the same states. The app shows you which step you are on and what to do next.
howItWorks.steps_b1: Open: posted, visible to nearby people. Nothing is locked.
howItWorks.steps_b2: Matched: someone accepted. Both sides now see contact details and the frozen reference rate.
howItWorks.steps_b3: Locked: the crypto side deposited funds into the escrow contract. Only now is it worth meeting.
howItWorks.steps_b4: Released: both confirmed the handover. The contract paid out and you can rate each other.
howItWorks.escrow_body: Funds are held by a smart contract, not by Nomadia and not by the other person. Neither party can move them alone. Release needs both confirmations. If the counterparty confirmed and the depositor goes quiet, the funds still go to the person who paid cash.
howItWorks.price_body: The implied rate of every offer is compared against a live market reference for USDC and USDT. Within 3% reads as fair. Beyond 15% is flagged as far from market. When an offer is matched, that reference is frozen and shown on the trade page, so a later disagreement is judged against the price both of you saw.
howItWorks.limits_body: Limits follow how strongly the identity is verified. They are per trade, and they apply to both the poster and the person accepting.
howItWorks.limits_b1: No sign-in: up to $100, a contact channel is required.
howItWorks.limits_b2: Wallet, Google or Apple: up to $500.
howItWorks.limits_b3: Telegram with phone verification: up to $1500.
howItWorks.trust_body: Ratings come only from released trades and only from the two participants, one each. Vouching is separate: every member has an invite link, and anyone who signs in through it carries that member as their voucher on every offer. Neither signal can be bought.
howItWorks.meetup_body: The meetup is the one moment the app cannot protect. A few habits keep it uneventful.
howItWorks.meetup_b1: Choose a public place with cameras: a bank lobby, a hotel reception, a busy café.
howItWorks.meetup_b2: Check that the escrow shows Locked before you travel.
howItWorks.meetup_b3: Count the cash together, then confirm. Confirm only after the money has changed hands.
howItWorks.meetup_b4: Never move the conversation to a different offer, amount or wallet at the last minute.
howItWorks.dispute_body: Either side can open a dispute while funds are locked. A neutral arbiter reviews the on-chain state and the frozen rate, then decides where the funds go. During the test phase the arbiter is the Nomadia team.
howItWorks.expiry_body: An open offer stays visible for seven days, then expires on its own. Matched offers do not expire; they end by release, refund or dispute.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.intro: What Nomadia is, what it holds, what it records, and what it does not yet do. Written to be accurate today rather than to sound impressive.
compliance.what_body: Nomadia is a matching board for people who want to exchange cash and crypto in person, plus an open-source escrow contract that holds the crypto side until both people confirm. Nomadia does not hold funds, convert currency, or move money on anyone's behalf.
compliance.custody_body: The escrow contract is non-custodial. Funds are deposited by the trader into the contract and can only be released by the rules written in it. Nomadia's servers hold no keys that can move user funds. The contract source is public on GitHub.
compliance.limits_body: Trade size is capped per trade according to how the person is identified. The caps exist to keep anonymous activity small and to make larger trades traceable to a verified channel.
compliance.limits_b1: Anonymous: up to $100 per trade, contact channel required.
compliance.limits_b2: Wallet signature, Google or Apple: up to $500 per trade.
compliance.limits_b3: Telegram with phone verification: up to $1500 per trade.
compliance.data_body: We store offer details (amounts, currency, city), the namespaced identity of the two participants, ratings, funnel events, and the reference rate frozen at match time. We do not collect identity documents, selfies, or bank details. Contact details are shown only to the two participants of a matched trade.
compliance.status_body: Nomadia runs on the Base Sepolia test network with test tokens. No real money moves. There are no fees. This phase exists to test the flow with real people before any mainnet release.
compliance.notYet_title: What we do not do yet
compliance.notYet_body: We prefer to list this plainly.
compliance.notYet_b1: No sanctions or PEP screening of participants. Planned before mainnet.
compliance.notYet_b2: No money-services licence in any jurisdiction. The non-custodial design is intended to keep Nomadia outside that scope; a legal review is in progress.
compliance.notYet_b3: No identity document verification. Tiers rely on wallet signatures and platform sign-ins.
compliance.responsibility_body: You are responsible for following the laws that apply to you, including tax reporting and any local rules on cash transactions. Nomadia is a tool for two people who choose to trade with each other.
compliance.contact_body: Questions, reports, or a takedown request: reach the team through the Telegram bot @nomadp2pbot or open an issue on GitHub.

notes.partnerCowork: Coworking space that hosts Nomadia meetups. Staff know the escrow flow, there is wifi, a table and a camera at the door. Finish the whole trade here.
notes.bank: Cameras, a security guard and other customers. Count the cash at the counter, not on the street.
notes.post: Public counter with cameras and daytime staff. Good for small amounts.
notes.municipal: Public building with security at the entrance. Daytime only.
notes.police: Open 24h. Meeting in front of the station is a strong signal both sides are honest.
notes.hotel: Lobbies are lit, staffed around the clock and used to strangers waiting.
notes.mall: Crowded, air conditioned, cameras everywhere. Pick a cafe with a view of the corridor.

map.title: Where to meet
map.subtitle: Every trade ends face to face. These are the places we know are safe: partner venues that host Nomadia meetups, and public spots with cameras and people around.

map.partnerBody: Places that have agreed to host Nomadia meetups. Say you are here for a Nomadia trade, take a table, finish the escrow on your phones.
map.becomePartner: Run a cafe or coworking here? Message us.
map.publicBody: Not affiliated with Nomadia. Chosen because they have cameras, staff and daylight.
map.rule_daylight: Meet in daylight, inside the venue, never in a car or a side street.
map.rule_inside: Bring only the amount in the offer. Count cash at the table, in view of the camera.
map.rule_onchain: Release the escrow only after the cash is in your hand and counted. Never before.
map.rule_walk: Anything feels off? Walk away. The escrow refunds on expiry, nobody loses.
